verdict.line: You lose if you fight through her Test of Spirit spirit or let trades drag past 3-4 seconds; you win if you pull-and-burst her before the spirit tether or tentacles ever come into play.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by E (Test of Spirit): if the spirit stands between you two and you swing through it, that damage echoes back onto you, and if you disengage too far you become a Vessel that spawns tentacles to heal her. Darius wins by keeping trades short and precise with E (Apprehend) into R (Noxian Guillotine); Illaoi wins any fight that stretches out because her passive tentacles and 4s W (Harsh Lesson) cooldown out-sustain your bleed.

theirWindow.when: her E (Test of Spirit) is on you
theirWindow.what: Don't swing Q (Decimate) or autos through the spirit itself and don't run far enough to snap the tether — either backs off just enough to stay safe, or eats the echo/Vessel penalty. Fight only when the spirit is dead or off cooldown.

yourWindow.when: your E (Apprehend) is up and hers is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Pull her in, stack Q and autos for Hemorrhage, and finish with R (Noxian Guillotine) the moment she's isolated. This is your solo-kill window — the head-to-head data favors you here specifically.

start.why: Run by 85.6% of Darius players (49.6% WR, 847 games) — the extra sustain and damage matter because you need to win short trades outright, not out-heal a prolonged one.

boots.why: 76.3% pick, 51% WR — Illaoi's kit is almost entirely physical autos, W leaps, and tentacle procs, so flat damage reduction blunts every poke source she has.

core.why: Highest-winning core path (61.4% over 70 games) — the active haste lets you close the gap for E and stay on her before she can reset with W.
Builds toward the same core path and gives you the HP buffer to survive tentacle chip while you set up your all-in.
Completes the top-performing path — converts your own bled damage into healing, which matters since you're racing her sustain, not out-lasting it.

situational.when: you're ahead and want more survivability during your all-in window (61.5% WR path)
her team stacks magic damage elsewhere and you need the resistances more than Death's Dance

runes.keystoneWhy: 49.8% WR at 25.7% pick — Conqueror's stacking adaptive force and healing reward exactly the sustained-trade pattern this lane forces on you once E and Q are landing repeatedly. Master-tier Darius players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery, 7,998 games) for a burst-reset that suits a more dive/all-in playstyle around level 6 — take that if you're leaning on the R execute window over prolonged trading.

summoners.why: Highest-winning combo (50.8% WR, 63.1% pick) — Ghost closes distance for your E pull and lets you stick through her W leap-away; Ignite (48.1% WR, 30.5% pick) is the alternative if you want harder lock on your level 6 solo-kill window instead.

playing.title: Farm behind minions
playing.detail: OP.GG's read holds here: soak minion damage and land Q (Decimate)'s wide swing on the wave to stack Hemorrhage without stepping into her Q (Tentacle Smash, range 850) or W (Harsh Lesson) range.

playing.title: Never hit the spirit
playing.detail: When her E is on you, the spirit stands between you — swinging Q or autos through it echoes that damage straight back onto you. Fight around it or wait for it to expire.

playing.title: Don't run from the tether
playing.detail: If you flee too far from the spirit you become a Vessel, spawning tentacles that heal her on every hit. Staying close but not swinging is safer than disengaging.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown windows
playing.detail: The moment her E (16-12s) and W are both down, pull with E (Apprehend), stack bleed, and close with R (Noxian Guillotine) — this is where the data's solo-kill edge lives.

playing.title: Respect her Q poke
playing.detail: Tentacle Smash has 850 range and buffs tentacle damage — don't stand static at max range for free chip while waiting to trade.

playing.title: Keep trades under 3-4 seconds
playing.detail: Her passive tentacles and 4s W cooldown mean anything that stretches out starts favoring her sustain over your bleed damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner spells here are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reading on the spirit-echo mechanic and trade timing is my own analysis, not OP.GG's.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Illaoi’s (E) when fighting her. Try to get your passive stacks up by dealing damage while staying behind minions.
